title: 油價崩跌背後：市場真正押注的不是下跌
executive_summary: The video discusses the recent 10%+ drop in crude oil prices and the market's reaction to it. The host argues that simply following news headlines and price movements is not a viable long-term trading strategy. Instead, the video aims to provide a deeper understanding of the underlying logic of crude oil futures, the divergence between major energy institutions (IEA and OPEC), and the tail risk in options markets.
